title: Exposed database password leaks

items.issue: A root database credential is hard-coded in source code.
items.resolution: The current connection-pool code uses the authenticated login object's runtime password; no root password is present in MyClass.java.

items.issue: Root and new-user passwords are added to MySQL batch commands and written to createUser.bat.
items.resolution: Signup now uses JDBC directly, does not create createUser.bat, and clears password character arrays after use.

items.issue: The logged-in database password is written into tempBack.bat for backups.
items.resolution: MainScreen no longer writes tempBack.bat. BackupAndRestore uses a temporary MySQL option file with a direct ProcessBuilder invocation, then cleans it up.

recommended_action: Remove credentials from source and generated batch files, rotate the exposed root password, and use protected configuration.
